title: Ensure multi-factor authentication is enforced for the organization
description: Not observable through Azure DevOps: Azure DevOps Services signs users in through Microsoft Entra ID, where multi-factor authentication is a Conditional Access policy, and Azure DevOps Server through Active Directory. Neither is readable through the Azure DevOps API, so a verdict from Azure DevOps data alone would be invented.
remediation: Require MFA with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy that covers the Azure DevOps application (Entra admin center -> Protection -> Conditional Access), then turn on Organization settings -> Policies -> "Enable IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows" so the policy also governs personal access tokens and SSH. On Azure DevOps Server, enforce MFA in the Active Directory or AD FS sign-in in front of it.
fixSummary: Require MFA with Conditional Access at Entra admin center -> Protection -> Conditional Access.
